title: Power's Omari Hardwick Reveals Why He Doesn't Miss Playing Ghost
htmlContent:
James St. Patrick, commonly known as Ghost, is a central character in the popular crime drama Power. Portrayed by actor Omari Hardwick, Ghost is a complex character involved in various illegal activities, including drug trafficking and money laundering. Throughout six seasons, Ghost's story arc is both captivating and tragic.

Ghost was introduced in the first season of Power as a successful nightclub owner who was also the leader of a large drug trafficking organization. Despite his outward success, Ghost was deeply unhappy and wanted to leave his criminal lifestyle behind to focus on his legitimate business ventures. However, he found himself continually pulled back into the world of crime, as his drug empire became more lucrative and his enemies grew more dangerous.

One of the most compelling aspects of Ghost's character is his duality. On one hand, he is a ruthless criminal who will stop at nothing to protect his interests. On the other hand, he is a devoted husband and father who deeply loves his family. Ghost's relationships with his wife Tasha and his children, particularly his son Tariq, are central to the show's narrative.

Throughout the series, Ghost's life becomes increasingly complicated as he tries to balance his illegal activities with his desire to leave his criminal past behind. He is constantly pursued by law enforcement, as well as rival drug organizations and dangerous individuals who want to take him down. As the stakes get higher and the danger increases, Ghost's moral compass becomes increasingly compromised, and he is forced to make difficult decisions that often have dire consequences.

One of the most notable aspects of Ghost's character is his relationship with his former best friend, Tommy Egan. The two men grew up together and were partners in their drug operation, but their friendship becomes strained as Ghost tries to leave the criminal world behind. As the series progresses, their relationship becomes increasingly complex, with moments of loyalty and betrayal on both sides.

Ultimately, Ghost's story comes to a tragic end in the series finale. Without giving away any spoilers, the conclusion of the series is a fitting end for Ghost's character, bringing together many of the show's themes and character arcs in a satisfying way.

In conclusion, James St. Patrick, aka Ghost, is a central and complex character in the hit television series Power. His story is one of duality, as he tries to balance his criminal activities with his desire for a legitimate life. Ghost's relationships with his family and former friends, as well as his struggles with morality and loyalty, make him a fascinating and compelling character. The conclusion of his story is both satisfying and heartbreaking, bringing his character arc to a fitting end.

On a recent episode of "Jemele Hill Is Unbothered,' Hill asked Omari Hardwick if he miss playing Ghost.

'No," said Hardwick.

Why is that you ask?

"Because the colors are all in me. You got to remember the colors are already there," he added.
